biological_rationale: Suppresses T-cell receptor signaling and cytokine release
clinical_evidence: Clinical responses occur in both PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumors; ORR is similar regardless of PD-L1 level
predictive_value: Low (Not useful for clinical patient stratification)
limitations: Assay variability, spatial heterogeneity, and inducible expression

biological_rationale: UV-induced somatic mutations generate immunogenic neoantigens
clinical_evidence: Responders have significantly higher median TMB (~53-61 mut/Mb) vs non-responders (~13-19 mut/Mb)
predictive_value: Moderate-High (Higher TMB correlates with clinical benefit)
limitations: High sequencing cost, turn-around time, and overlap of response across TMB range

biological_rationale: Execute target cell lysis and cytotoxic response
clinical_evidence: Dense infiltration at invasive margin or tumor core is associated with responding lesions
limitations: Lacks standardized clinical scoring and is subject to biopsy sampling bias

clinical_evidence: High baseline IFN-gamma transcriptomic signature correlates with objective response and longer PFS
limitations: Requires high-quality RNA from fresh-frozen tissue or standardized expression assays

biological_rationale: Reflects tumor burden and real-time disease response
clinical_evidence: Rapid clearance of ctDNA (by week 6) is a strong positive predictor of DFS and OS
limitations: Shedding variability, low sensitivity in patients with low-volume localized disease

biological_rationale: Presents tumor neoantigens to cytotoxic CD8+ T-cells
clinical_evidence: Loss of HLA-I (e.g. B2M or TAP mutations) is associated with acquired resistance and progression
limitations: Baseline low expression is hard to distinguish from somatic genetic loss

biological_rationale: Reflects T-cell expansion and clonal specificity
clinical_evidence: Clonal expansion of T-cells post-treatment is observed in responders, indicating focused immune response
limitations: Complex high-throughput sequencing of TCR repertoire and variable kinetics
